# cape.rip

> An independent community hub for Cape Cellular users. A fair, anonymous pool of
> Cape referral codes, crowdsourced speed tests, carrier comparisons, coverage
> maps, and a live mirror of Cape's service status. Not affiliated with Cape
> Cellular.

## How Cape Cellular referrals work

Cape's own description (cape.co homepage): "every Cape subscriber has a unique
referral code that they can share with their family, friends, or even strangers,
to give you and your referral $20 off your monthly bill." And: "Get 5 active
referrals, and your plan is completely free."

- A successful referral gives **both** parties **$20/month off**, for as long as
  both remain subscribed.
- The bonus caps at **5 active referrals** per subscriber.
- Cape's early adopter price is **$70/month** (permanent for anyone joining
  before the end of 2026). With 4 referrals the plan is fully covered.
- If a referral cancels, that $20 credit ends on the next billing cycle and the
  slot opens up.

## How cape.rip works

- Codes are submitted anonymously and validated against Cape's format
  (`^[A-Z0-9]{8}$`).
- One code is shown per visit, picked at random and weighted by
  `1 / (min(impressions, 10) + 1)` so less-shown codes come up first. Every code
  in the pool is treated identically — there is no owner, admin, or promoted
  code.
- Codes expire after **7 days**. Submitters can resubmit weekly.
- A code reported broken three times, or redeemed five times, leaves the pool.
- Speed tests measure against a Cloudflare Worker that only responds on Cape's
  network, and the results are signed server-side so they can't be faked.
- No signup, no login, no analytics. IP addresses are HMAC-SHA256 hashed before
  storage and retention is capped at 7 days.

## Network

Cape is a heavy MVNO running its own mobile core on top of the T-Mobile and
AT&T networks.

## Disclaimer

cape.rip is an independent community tool. It is **not affiliated with, endorsed
by, or operated by Cape Cellular**.
